**Step 6 - Grams:** Cooked meat-like density of about 0.9 g/ml. 19 ml × 0.9 ≈ 17 g.

**Step 7 - Energy:** Cooked, pan-fried bacon is about 540 kcal/100 g. 17 g × 5.4 ≈ 92 kcal.

**Step 8 - Sanity check:** A few thin strips covering about an eighth of a small plate should weigh roughly 15–20 g, so 17 g and about 90 kcal is plausible.
